method: Exhaustive eligible-team/topological-list enumeration with mathematically safe incumbent lower-bound pruning
coverage_argument: Given any feasible nonpreemptive schedule, add each team chronological order to the precedence DAG. Its topological extension is enumerated with the same eligible-team choices; earliest team/dependency recurrence cannot finish later. Intentional-idle feasible schedules are included through a no-worse representative. Branch lower bounds are scheduled start + precedence-only tail and (sum team availability + unscheduled work)/2; both cannot exceed a representative achievable makespan.
claim_used_in_canonical: Verified feasible best-known; canonical and artwork do not need or claim global optimality.
